collection_method: Claude Code WebSearch tool (Brave Search-backed), live interactive query, one query per prompt, first-page results only
engine_caveat: This is Claude's own grounded web search (a general web index), not a direct query to ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot or Perplexity. No free API access exists to those engines, so this audit does not claim to represent them. See methodology.
prompt_bank_version: weekly-variant-v1 (first run — no prior weekly_variants.json existed in the repo to compare against)
generation_note: 40 prompts generated by combining each of the 13 distinct subjects from prompts/prompt_bank.json core_15 with one weekly_variant_axes value each (sector, service, location, buyer_role, buying_stage, problem, or outcome; never more than 2 axes stacked), phrased as natural buyer questions, per the generation_note in prompt_bank.json. This is the first ISO-week run of this step recorded in the repo.

summary_for_briefing.observation: ENZ did not appear in any of the 40 weekly variant queries, in contrast to 1/15 in the core set (core-14). This is consistent with ENZ's narrow, hotel-specific positioning: nearly every variant swapped the sector away from hotels (care homes, PBSA, offices, commercial property/asset managers) or broadened the service/location framing, and ENZ's own strongest query (core-14, 'vendor-agnostic energy-efficiency advice to UK hotel groups') was the one query type that consistently returned ENZ in the core set. The clearest strategic signal: three consultancies use near-identical 'independent/vendor-agnostic' positioning language to ENZ but for different sectors or locations — Reclaim Energy (care homes, weekly-37), Arc Renewables and Inenergy (commercial property, weekly-38), and Cotswold Energy Consultants (offices, weekly-13) — plus Ridgewater Energy, a Dorset-headquartered independent adviser for care homes (weekly-33). None are on the original seed watch-list.
